items.title: File the Baldwin County lodging tax return
items.authority: Baldwin County Sales and Use Tax Department
items.description: Baldwin County's sales, use and rental taxes, which cover lodging, are filed and paid electronically through My Alabama Taxes by 4 p.m. Central on the 20th of the month after the month of the taxable transactions (next business day if a weekend or holiday). Returns are monthly at first, and a return is required even with no taxable activity. Call 251-972-6844 with questions about the county portion of an account. The link is the state's local lodgings tax FAQ (the county's own page moved).

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Baldwin County sales, use and rental tax return
items.authority: Baldwin County Sales and Use Tax Department
items.description: Baldwin County's sales, use and rental taxes are filed and paid electronically through My Alabama Taxes by 4 p.m. Central on the 20th of the month after the period (next business day if a weekend or holiday). New filers file monthly, and a return is required even with no taxable activity; quarterly or annual filing can be requested in writing after 12 months. Questions about the county portion: 251-972-6844.

items.title: File the Jefferson County lodging tax return
items.authority: Jefferson County Department of Revenue
items.description: The lodgings tax return (Form LL) must be postmarked by the 20th of the month after the reporting period; most filers use My Alabama Taxes (select Jefferson County, code 7537) and must not file both on paper and electronically. The tax applies to rentals of fewer than 180 days. Some cities in the county levy their own lodging taxes.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Jefferson County sales tax return
items.authority: Jefferson County Department of Revenue
items.description: Jefferson County collects its own sales tax, separate from the state's. The return and payment must reach the county Department of Revenue by the 20th of the month after the period, filed through My Alabama Taxes (select Jefferson County; do not also file on paper). Since January 1, 2025 the general and special revenue sales taxes are one return; seller's use tax and consumer's use tax each need their own return. A late return costs 10% of the tax (minimum $50) plus interest; a 5% discount applies to tax up to $100 and 2% above that if paid before the 20th.

items.title: File the Mobile County lodging tax return
items.authority: Mobile County License Commission
items.description: Lodging returns are due on or before the 20th of the month after the month the tax accrued; the county recommends filing through My Alabama Taxes (ONE SPOT). Late returns pay the greater of 10% or $50, and late payments 10%; a zero return filed on time avoids the $50 minimum. Operators in the City of Mobile also file the city's lodging tax form.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Mobile County sales and use tax return
items.authority: Mobile County License Commission
items.description: Mobile County's sales, use, lease and lodging tax returns are due on the 20th of the month after the period, filed through ONE SPOT in My Alabama Taxes (EFT by 4 p.m. Central). The general rate is 1.5% (1% county plus 0.5% school tax, not reported separately). A late return costs the greater of 10% or $50, a zero return must still be filed on time, and there is no on-time discount (penalty page dated 2016; confirm current rules). Phone 251-574-4800.
